notes.title: Sneak peak
notes.content:
There hasn't been any news for a while, but don't worry, Plague Architect is still in development!

Here's a preview of how the game is looking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119107/3efa97893bedf9c20ecca76f5045fdd868d91d15.png[/img]

There's still a lot of work to be done, and the game is still in the prototyping phase. However, development is now ramping up substantially.

Stay tuned for further updates.
